issues.problem: cd-to example 4: English 'as soon as he gets up' over-translates と + まず; the meaning is 'first thing after getting up'.
issues.action: Rewrote English: 'The first thing my grandfather does after getting up is go for a walk.'

issues.problem: cd-to contrast たら: model sentence 駅に着くと、いつも電話が鳴る is semantically odd (phone ringing every time one arrives).
issues.action: Replaced with the habit sentence 駅に着くと、いつも母に電話する.

issues.problem: cd-ba contrast と: claimed たら cannot replace ば in 〜ばいい; false, どうしたらいいですか is fully standard.
issues.action: Restated: 〜ば〜ほど is fixed to ば; どうすればいい / どうしたらいい both work, と does not.

issues.problem: cd-tara contrast ば: 'ば owns 〜ばいい' repeated the same false exclusivity claim.
issues.action: Restated: 〜ば〜ほど takes only ば; 〜たらどう for suggestions; 〜たらいい and 〜ばいい are both standard.
